name: Soft almond
logic: A calm, continuous almond with softened joins. The original eight dot iris remains the clearest link to the company.
caution: The closest evolution of the supplied mark. Fine dots need a small size check.

name: Pill lens
logic: A capsule turns the familiar button pill into an eye. Straight upper and lower spans make the mark compact and steady.
caution: Strong family resemblance to the controls. Can read as a switch without the iris.

name: Soft rectangle
logic: A continuous rounded enclosure gives the eye a device like frame while retaining a living iris.
caution: More architectural than organic. Avoid letting the outline resemble a camera housing.

name: Open lids
logic: Two separate arcs leave the corners open, suggesting a relaxed blink rather than an enclosing shield.
caution: Airy and responsive. Open corners may weaken the silhouette at small sizes.

name: Sculpted lens
logic: A heavier upper lid and a quiet lower curve create a filled, sculptural eye with a clear aperture.
caution: A stronger app icon shape. The weighted upper lid needs balance beside Comfortaa.

name: Ellipse orbit
logic: An elliptical eye emphasizes continuous observation and a generous aperture without sharp corners.
caution: Soft and simple, with less explicit eye character than the almond.

name: Lens brackets
logic: Two curved brackets frame the iris. The missing top and bottom strokes make the eye feel open and light.
caution: Distinct and spacious. Brackets can imply scanning rather than comfort.

name: Resting blink
logic: A shallow eye and low iris describe a relaxed eyelid with less vertical occupation.
caution: Efficient in a menu bar. The compressed eye can look sleepy.

name: Paired gaze
logic: Two separate eyes distribute the company’s eight circles equally across both sides, making bilateral movement part of the identity.
caution: Directly expresses two eyes. Both small irises compete for limited menu bar pixels.

name: Living seed
logic: An asymmetric upper lid suggests movement while the iris holds a stable central anchor.
caution: Memorable organic tension. It must remain neutral rather than suggest unequal eye health.

name: Round aperture
logic: A circular outer frame contains a simple eye cut and the eight circle iris, joining observation with a focus dial.
caution: Robust circular icon, with a risk of unnecessary nested boundaries.

name: Petal iris
logic: Eight rounded radial strokes reinterpret the company’s circles as a soft iris inside the eye.
caution: More legible strokes at small sizes. It can resemble a loading spinner if animated continuously.

name: Forward gaze
logic: The iris moves gently to one side inside a generous almond, suggesting attention shifting beyond the screen.
caution: A clear eye with directional character. The resting logo should not appear to watch a particular person.

name: Ribbon fold
logic: A pair of offset lid ribbons shares rounded endings with the pill controls. The iris sits in their open overlap.
caution: Dynamic without arrows. Heavy terminals can crowd the iris.

name: Constellation eye
logic: Eight dots form the eye boundary itself, letting the company motif become the whole silhouette. A pupil makes the eye reading explicit.
caution: The strongest departure from a conventional eye icon. Sparse dots need careful spacing at 16 pixels.

name: Quiet almond
rationale: A flatter upper and lower curve gives the eight circle iris more room while keeping the original almond calm.
tradeoff: The low profile feels relaxed, though the outline takes less height in a menu bar.

name: Full aperture
rationale: A fuller almond and larger iris use more of the canvas and keep the eight circles distinct at small sizes.
tradeoff: The taller gaze feels more alert and may carry less of the original mark’s quiet mood.

name: Bold capsule
rationale: A thicker capsule outline and a wider iris make the button pill read as an eye at menu size.
tradeoff: The stronger border can still suggest a control when shown without the wordmark.

name: Aperture capsule
rationale: A transparent almond cut through a solid capsule turns the pill into a lens while retaining the circle motif.
tradeoff: The dense silhouette depends on the background showing clearly through the aperture.

name: Lidded frame
rationale: Shallow inward bends along the frame’s top and bottom edges give the rounded rectangle a softer eye shape.
tradeoff: The bent edges make the frame less literal as a device window.

name: Bold frame
rationale: A heavier soft rectangle and larger radial iris keep the eight circle motif centered and defined at small sizes.
tradeoff: The horizontal sides can still read as a screen around the eye.

name: Open lids, calm aperture
rationale: The rounded upper arc and closer lower lid make the two open strokes more deliberate while the tighter eight circle iris retains the company motif.
tradeoff: The heavier lid reads clearly at small sizes, though the separated corners still depend on a crisp silhouette.

name: Open lids, relaxed slit
rationale: A shallow upper lid and a gently rising lower curve create a calm narrow aperture with the iris visibly centered between them.
tradeoff: The open corners stay expressive, while the smaller aperture places the iris closer to the upper lid.

name: Sculpted lens, tapered lid
rationale: The filled upper lid tapers from a broad center into fine corners, leaving a spacious lower aperture and an intact eight circle iris.
tradeoff: The wide negative space feels light, while the narrower lid carries less app icon weight.

name: Sculpted lens, bold lid
rationale: A taller filled canopy and deeper lower curve turn the eye into a more sculptural mark while keeping the pupil and eight circles legible.
tradeoff: The strong upper mass holds at menu size, though it may feel heavier beside Comfortaa.

name: Soft capsule orbit
rationale: Flatter crown and base curves evolve the ellipse into a soft capsule orbit, preserving continuous enclosure around the eight circle iris.
tradeoff: The compact contour is steady at small sizes, with less natural almond character than a curved eye.

name: Open orbit
rationale: A small opening on the right turns the closed ellipse into an orbit path that suggests observation in motion while retaining the central motif.
tradeoff: The gap adds direction, though it can read as a tracking symbol at a glance.

name: Soft parenthesis
rationale: Thicker rounded parentheses give the open lens brackets a friendlier silhouette while the eight-dot iris stays centered and clear.
tradeoff: The compact iris detail may still soften at 16 px.

name: Four soft corners
rationale: Splitting each bracket into upper and lower arcs adds breathing room around the same eight-dot iris and makes the gaze feel lighter.
tradeoff: The extra gaps weaken the eye outline at very small sizes.

name: Resting capsule
rationale: A flatter, rounder shell keeps the shallow eye compact while a low eight-dot iris preserves the resting gaze.
tradeoff: The capsule silhouette can read as a control without the iris.

name: Resting open lids
rationale: Separate shallow lid arcs leave the corners open and keep the lowered eight-dot iris visible in a calm, horizontal mark.
tradeoff: The open corners may close up visually at 16 px.

name: Paired pearls
rationale: Rounder paired eyes hold four iris dots and a small pupil each, splitting the eight-circle motif evenly across both sides.
tradeoff: The two pupils add detail to an already dense small mark.

name: Converging pair
rationale: A larger iris group in each rounded eye turns the paired gaze gently inward while preserving four company dots per side.
tradeoff: The shared inward direction can make the pair feel more intent than relaxed.

name: Seed sweep
rationale: The asymmetric seed becomes two rounded lid strokes, with a heavier upper sweep and the eight circle iris held at center.
tradeoff: Open terminals feel light and comfortable, though the isolated arcs rely on their separation to read as an eye at menu size.

name: Seed cutout
rationale: A solid asymmetric seed uses an eye shaped negative space for its aperture, giving the organic concept a compact filled silhouette.
tradeoff: The stronger body holds up when small, though it has more visual weight beside Comfortaa.

name: Aperture disc
rationale: The circular frame becomes a filled disc with an eye shaped opening, leaving the eight circle iris floating cleanly in the aperture.
tradeoff: The simple outer silhouette suits an app mark, though the negative opening needs contrast from its background.

name: Orbit iris
rationale: Eight circles move from the iris to a rounded perimeter dial while a simple stroked eye keeps the gaze explicit.
tradeoff: The perimeter carries the company motif clearly, though its dotted circle feels more like a focus dial than a continuous frame.

name: Capsule bloom
rationale: Eight short rounded capsules turn the radial strokes into soft petals while keeping the pupil and almond immediately legible.
tradeoff: The repeated petals may feel more floral or animated than a quiet iris.

name: Eight circle iris
rationale: Eight separate circles make the company motif explicit and keep the iris construction simple at small sizes.
tradeoff: The dot ring is less distinctive than radial petals and can read as an aperture.

name: Soft directional almond
rationale: A rounder right lid gives the almond a gentle forward lean, with the eight circle iris shifted just enough to suggest attention moving outward.
tradeoff: The softened right corner reduces the crispness of the eye silhouette.

name: Cutout gaze
rationale: A solid almond rim carved around a clear aperture makes a bolder app mark while the offset eight circle iris preserves the forward gaze.
tradeoff: The heavier rim can dominate the small iris beside Comfortaa.

name: Almond Ribbon
rationale: The steeper opposing arcs restore a readable eye silhouette while keeping eight iris dots open between the rounded offset ends.
tradeoff: The fuller almond tension feels more expressive and less like a pill control.

name: Pill Fold
rationale: Flatter curves carry the pill control language into both lids around a centered eight dot iris.
tradeoff: The shallow upper lid leaves less clearance above the iris and can suggest a switch.

name: Even Constellation
rationale: Eight equally weighted circles form the eye boundary while a larger center dot establishes the pupil.
tradeoff: Even spacing gives the small mark rhythm but leaves larger gaps in the eye contour.

name: Anchored Constellation
rationale: Larger corner circles anchor the eye while six smaller arc points retain the eight circle company motif.
tradeoff: Varied circle sizes soften the rhythm and make the boundary more decorative.
